findings.title: Bare-Int ratchet exempts a whole line containing radix:, so Int(s, radix: 16) + Int(d) on one line passes
findings.evidence: next if /radix:/ skips the entire line (raised by Higia, remediation B13)
findings.fix: Strip the labeled radix call before matching instead of skipping the line; plant the mixed form in the self-test
findings.impact: A trapping Int(Double) conversion can slip into a WireTypes file on a line that also parses a radix
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B13

findings.title: SHA-pinned actions have no updater: no .github/dependabot.yml for github-actions
findings.evidence: actions/checkout and softprops/action-gh-release are SHA-pinned; nothing bumps the pins (raised by Jano, remediation B13)
findings.impact: A security release of a pinned action is never picked up
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B13

findings.title: Empty COVERAGE_FLOOR argument falls back to 0 (report-only) via default expansion
findings.evidence: Makefile defaults COVERAGE_FLOOR ?= 90 and CI passes 90 explicitly; only an explicit empty value disables the floor (raised by Nemesis, remediation B13)
findings.fix: None required; documented behavior for local experiments
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B13

findings.title: validate.sh mixes the ratchet script plain check lines with its own coloured ok/fail output
findings.evidence: Cosmetic output format mix (raised by Higia, remediation B13)
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B13
